title: J.B. Rhine's parapsychology lab at Duke and his work with Owens

tellings.quote: JB Ryan who actually worked with Ted Owens for a long time. He was the founder of the first real official kind of parasychology institute, the Ryan Institute at an elite university at Duke, uh, 1931, I believe.
every Elite University from the ryin Center at Duke for I think that was 1931 to 1960

tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the Rhine parapsychology centre founded at Duke in 1931.

plain: The researcher J.B. Rhine is said to have founded the first real official institute for parapsychology, the study of psychic abilities, at Duke University around 1931, and to have worked for a long time with a man named Ted Owens. Michels says this himself in two different episodes, without naming a source; in the second he gives the center's run as 1931 to 1960 and does not mention Owens. The point is that psychic research once had a home at an elite American university.
